reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: clause 12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC or minimum-volume commitment by Customer, and clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, matching the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
Clause 12.4 exclusivity runs in Customer's favour (Vendor restrained from competing), correctly treated as acceptable and not flagged per detection guidance.

No redline or comment was proposed, which is appropriate for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier/requirements obligation remains.
